recordedFor: Fresh campaign after a Windows host idle gate, 2026-10-03

scope.candidate: Current tracked working tree plus the two QA runtime harnesses

unchangedInputsEvidence.description: Source/runtime/dependency hashes and harnesses are identical to this preserved earlier campaign; no samples pooled.

host.idleStartRule: Three consecutive samples at CPU <=10% and disk queue =0, approximately 5.5 seconds apart. Background rustc compilation was observed and left running.
host.limitation: Windows counters sampled before the run and after the interruption, not continuously during measurement. Existing bracketing CPU/I/O workload probes determine exclusions.

summary.interpretation: Multi buffered HTTP passes the full faster classification. Multi markup and MDN pass control stability with unresolved differences. Six other cases remain provisional. Idle start is not proof of uninterrupted host idleness.

protocol.scope: Final current-working-tree vs 0.9.1; fresh independent campaign, no pooling with historical samples
protocol.order: Six rotation/reversal permutations repeated twice; each variant in each position four times

noise.calibrationOrder: Three rotations, each variant occupies each position once
noise.calibrationContext: The same real workloads, three fresh variant processes and two observations per process as a measured round; calibration timings are discarded from performance analysis
noise.groupStatistic: Maximum of 12 bracketing probe values per metric, case and three-variant round
noise.threshold: Per case and metric: 1.5 times the median of three independent calibration group maxima; fixed before measured rounds. This is a heuristic outlier guard, not a calibrated false-positive probability.
noise.ioProbe: 8 sequential stat + readFile pairs on an independent 4 KiB fixture, same filesystem as workload
noise.filter: Discard complete three-variant round for a case when its CPU or I/O group maximum exceeds that case-specific threshold; never use crawl timing, paired effect or candidate performance for exclusion

statistics.control: 95% interval includes zero and lies within [-5,+5] percent
statistics.classification: Report faster/slower only when current/control stability passes and both current-vs-legacy and identical-current-vs-legacy intervals have that sign; otherwise unresolved. No universal non-regression claim.

protocol.stopping: Exactly three discarded calibration triplets then 12 measured rounds per suite; abort on functional/hash failures and preserve partial logs; no extra rounds, changed thresholds, pooling or concurrent benchmarks/builds/tests/cleanup
protocol.timing: Initialization, admission, crawl and disposal; independent probe work and output hashing excluded; profiling disabled; existing phase/CPU/RSS diagnostics identical across variants
